_notes.ftp: Functional Threshold Power (W). Best determined by a real 20-min test (FTP = 0.95 * 20-min best). Update when retested.
_notes.weight: Morning fasted (kg). Update when it drifts >~1 kg to keep W/kg displays honest.
_notes.bmr_kcal: Mifflin-St Jeor formula: 10*kg + 6.25*cm - 5*age + 5 (male) / -161 (female). Recompute when weight drifts.
_notes.resting_hr_bpm: Pull from Garmin via scripts/garmin_recovery.py or use null until you have a measurement.
_notes.hr_max_bpm_est: Rough 220-age estimate. Replace with measured value when known (lab test or peak from hard intervals).
_notes.power_zones_w: Coggan zones at the given FTP. Update with FTP changes. Format: [low, high] inclusive watts.
_notes.protein_target_g_per_day: Range in grams. Use higher end when running aggressive deficit to preserve lean mass.
